headline: Dow Drops 1.1% and Gold Slips as Hawkish Federal Reserve Rate Expectations Rise
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1.1% while gold prices fell 2.9% toward 14-month lows. Investor sentiment was pressured by elevated US 10-year Treasury yields at 5.08% and hawkish Fed signals.
why: Higher US Treasury yields raise borrowing costs globally and reduce the appeal of non-yielding assets like gold.

impacts.name: Dow Jones Industrial Average
impacts.why: Rising Treasury yields and rate hike concerns weighed on US equity valuations.
